CVE-2026-0864: when the configparser module writes a configuration file, a multi-line value containing carriage return characters (\r) could inject unexpected keys and values into the file if an attacker controls the value. It is fixed on the CPython 3.11 branch by https://github.com/python/cpython/commit/274de100bbf4345bd0c23ef5b446722e9e636908, for https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/143927, first released in CPython 3.11.16. See https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-0864. Checked Lib/configparser.py for the line-ending normalization that change adds in the python-3.11 package of every build published in the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository, 3.11.14-r0 to 3.11.18-r4 (24 builds), x86_64 and aarch64; both architectures agree. 3.11.14-r0 and 3.11.15-r0 to 3.11.15-r9 ship the unmodified configparser.py of CPython 3.11.14 and 3.11.15, which lacks it; 3.11.15-r10 is the first build that carries a backport of the fix, and every later build carries it, as a backport or from CPython 3.11.16 and later. The range ends at 3.11.15-r10.

CVE-2026-0864: configparser wrote multi-line values containing a bare carriage return without continuation indentation, so an attacker who controls a written value could inject extra keys and values into the file. Upstream fixed it in https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/143927 (3.13 commit https://github.com/python/cpython/commit/aaf850fd333cd89e9aada03d92aaa788a6cb1bb8), first released in CPython 3.13.15 (https://mail.python.org/archives/list/security-announce@python.org/thread/CV4NE6AFCRJL7XQOHX7J5TSDHUWVWGJS/). We compared Lib/configparser.py in the python-3.13 package of every build published in the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository, 3.13.12-r0 to 3.13.18-r4, x86_64 and aarch64, after verifying each package against its index checksum, with the upstream release files; both architectures agree. Builds up to 3.13.14-r0 ship the unchanged upstream 3.13.12, 3.13.13 or 3.13.14 file, without the fix. 3.13.14-r1 to 3.13.14-r3 ship a file identical to the upstream 3.13.15 file, which has the fix, and 3.13.15-r0 and every later build ship the upstream file for their version. The range ends at 3.13.14-r1.

We compared Lib/configparser.py, shipped in libpython-3.13-stdlib up to 3.13.14-1 and in libpython-3.13-minimal from 3.13.14-2, in every build published in the DHI Debian repository, 3.13.13-0 to 3.13.18-8, amd64 and arm64, after verifying each package against its index checksum, with the upstream release files; both architectures agree. Builds up to 3.13.14-0 ship the unchanged upstream 3.13.13 or 3.13.14 file, without the fix. 3.13.14-1 to 3.13.14-4 ship a file identical to the upstream 3.13.15 file, which has the fix, and 3.13.15-0 and every later build ship the upstream file for their version. The range ends at 3.13.14-1.
